semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Pedestrian inertial navigation relates to determining a person's position indoors through inertial sensors, which aligns closely with the concept of indoor positioning.

Collaborative SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a technique used for determining a device's position and mapping the environment simultaneously, which is directly related to indoor positioning.
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is a process that involves both locating the device in the environment and mapping the environment, crucial for indoor positioning.

parent_domains.justification: Spatial navigation involves navigating and understanding environments, both indoor and outdoor. Indoor positioning is a subfield of spatial navigation, focusing specifically on indoor environments.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Spatial navigation is the closest parent domain as it covers both indoor and outdoor navigational techniques and understanding, of which indoor positioning is a specific subdomain.

child_domains.justification: Facility location sometimes involves determining positions within a larger environment, which can involve techniques similar to indoor positioning.
Facility planning may require the use of indoor positioning systems to optimize layout and navigation within a facility.

closest_child_domain.justification: Facility planning is the closest child domain as it directly benefits from indoor positioning systems when planning the organization and layout of a facility.

sibling_domains.justification: Vision-based robot navigation involves using visual data to determine a robot's position and navigate, which is a conceptually similar process to indoor positioning.
Mobile AI encompasses technologies that include indoor positioning systems, which are often embedded in mobile devices to enhance their functionality.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Vision-based robot navigation is the closest sibling domain as it similarly involves determining position and navigating within an environment using sensors, akin to indoor positioning.

unrelated_domains.justification: This is more related to structuring and modeling indoor environments rather than determining position within them.
This domain is more about planning where to place facilities rather than determining positions within an existing environment.
Object tracking deals with monitoring the movement of objects rather than determining their static position within an environment.
Augmented reality involves overlaying digital content on physical environments and isn't primarily focused on positioning within those environments.
This covers a broader range of sensors which are not specifically related to indoor positioning.
Scene planning is more focused on the layout and design of a scene rather than determining specific position within it.
This involves prioritizing spatial resources or tasks, not determining position.
While related technologically, wireless communication itself is not focused on positioning.
Wireless networks support various applications, but are not necessarily specific to indoor positioning.
3D vision in general encompasses a broad range of technologies not specific to indoor positioning.
Virtual reality focuses on creating immersive environments rather than the positioning within them.
Human-robot interaction involves communication and task-sharing between humans and robots rather than specifically positioning either.
